mapper.update: UPDATE marketing_budget SET held=held+#{input.discount} WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND campaign_id=#{input.campaignId} AND version=#{input.version} AND (cap IS NULL OR held+spent+#{input.discount}<=cap)
mapper.select: SELECT campaign_id,version,CAST(discount AS CHAR) discount,status FROM marketing_budget_hold WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND order_id=#{order} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE marketing_budget SET held=held-#{hold.discount},spent=spent+#{hold.discount}0 WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND campaign_id=#{hold.campaignId} AND version=#{hold.version} AND held>=#{hold.discount}
UPDATE marketing_budget_hold SET status=#{status} WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND order_id=#{order} AND status='HELD'
mapper.select: SELECT budget_id,campaign_id,version,CAST(cap AS CHAR) cap,CAST(held AS CHAR) held,CAST(spent AS CHAR) spent FROM marketing_budget WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND budget_id>#{after} ORDER BY budget_id LIMIT #{limit}
